title: Human release approval record (T16, spec 17.21)
description: Machine-readable record of the human release approval. Lives with the release process (tag / environment), never committed as a pre-approval. scripts/verify-release-approval.py enforces every rule below with the standard library: decision must be approved, content_id must match the candidate, requester and approver must be two different humans, gate_pins must match the tree, and redistributable additionally requires signature proof that does not exist today.

content_id.description: Approved candidate identity (see schemas/release-candidate.json). A stale or foreign approval never matches.

decision.description: Any other value (including a missing record) blocks publication with exit 20.

approver.description: Human who approved. Must differ from requester; self-approval exits 20. Identity itself is enforced by the release environment (17.21); this record carries the claim the gate checks.

distribution.description: The only approvable value while signature.present is false (17.15).

gate_pins.description: Pinned sha256 digests of the gate scripts at approval time. Any drift exits 20.

review_ref.description: Pointer to the human review thread (issue / PR discussion). Advisory only.
